research_gates: Never add retrieved dataset text to GitHub without confirmed rights
Keep existing ANSG thesis original data and metric provenance unchanged
Use separate dialect-specific validated partitions for DAL; never mix official test with training
For Jordanian dialect, Amman/Salt is not Aqaba dialect; require a local-speech source or native-speaker evaluation
Measure authenticity with human dialect speakers, not just marker word frequency
Document source name, dialect granularity, licence, splits, record genre and hash
